correctness.rationale: Spectral decomposition of the categorical-product Laplacian produces the exact mean-zero edge-source potential. All nine potential levels are ordered under inequalities valid for a,b≥3; four explicitly enumerated cut sizes, mirrored by source/sink symmetry, yield the exact endpoint sum by graph coarea. The complementary diagonal uses the exact effective resistance. A manifestly positive polynomial establishes sharp universal upper bounds and a=3,b→infinity witnesses attainability in the limit. The actual packaged checker validates identities symbolically and exact rational edge columns on finite test graphs; finite checks are not misused as a general proof.

evidence: The 2023 source establishes general representation-theoretic facts about invariant cycle projections but its explicit Hamming-cube endpoint formula concerns a Cartesian hypercube.

Equal-size categorical products are strongly regular, but unequal-size ones have distinct coordinate Laplacian eigenvalues a(b-1) and b(a-1); the one-parameter specialization does not determine the asymmetric term.
broader_coverage.reasoning: General existence and invariance theorems are not quantitative universal covering formulas. The square special case is a proper subfamily; a formula on that diagonal does not imply the full off-diagonal classification or sharp global optimization.

value.rationale: The categorical rather than Cartesian product gives a natural graph Hodge/Banach-space family with an exact two-parameter norm classification, a strict imbalance correction from changing edge-current order, and sharp globally optimized unattained constants. The asymptotic distinction between one fixed coordinate size and both sizes growing provides structural insight; no speculative downstream theorem is required.
